e.title: **一个「暂存区」仓库：57 个寿险产品、六个国家，**每一条监管引用都是可点的链接****：`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`——**逐字自述为**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**并逐字说明**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on**」**；**⭐ 57 个产品**各自带一个**可执行的参考模型**，**并**逐格断言**复现其技术说明里的算例**（**实测：美国 12／英国 7／日本 9／法国 9／德国 10／韩国 10**）**；**⭐ 仓库里还有**18 个自己的文档工具脚本****（**检查锚点、生成引用链接、以及把法规引用取消链接等**）
e.title_en: A staging repository holding fifty-seven life insurance products across six countries where every regulatory citation is a working link: the lifelib-products repository states verbatim that it is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib, and verbatim that it is a staging ground rather than a package to install or depend on, with each of the fifty-seven products shipping an executable reference model that reproduces its own technical notes worked example asserted cell by cell, and with eighteen documentation tooling scripts of its own for checking anchors, generating citation links and unlinking specification citations.
e.title_hk: **一個「暫存區」倉庫：57 個壽險產品、六個國家，**每一條監管引用都是可點的連結****：`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`——**逐字自述為**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**並逐字說明**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on**」**；**⭐ 57 個產品**各自帶一個**可執行的參考模型**，**並**逐格斷言**複現其技術說明裡的算例**（**實測：美國 12／英國 7／日本 9／法國 9／德國 10／韓國 10**）**；**⭐ 倉庫裡還有**18 個自己的文件工具腳本****
e.summary: **lifelib-products**（`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一个「**暂存区**」仓库**，**逐字自述为**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**并逐字定性**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on: each library under `lifelib/libraries/` is written in the shape lifelib expects, and is drafted, reviewed and held to standard here until it lands upstream as a lifelib library of its own.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-03、最后推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**、**README 17,095 字节**、**tarball 解出 1,835 条路径**；**许可**：**⚠️ 本次文件清单里**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****。**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**，**它是本轮四条里**体量最大、覆盖面最宽**的一条**：**⭐ 它收录的是**主要寿险产品的产品规格，按国家组织**（**逐字**「**a library of product specifications for major life insurance products, organized by country**」**）**，**并附**建立负债现金流预测参考实现**所需的文档**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **每个产品都有可执行的参考模型，且逐格断言****——**逐字**「**All fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model in `<library>/products/<product>/`, beside the documents that specify it — twelve in `lifelib/libraries/uslib/`, seven in `lifelib/libraries/uklib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/jplib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/frlib/`, ten in `lifelib/libraries/delib/` and ten in `lifelib/libraries/krlib/`, each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell.**」**；**② **六套库都「**在形状上就是 lifelib 的库**」****——**逐字**「**All six are lifelib libraries in shape: they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link.**」**；**③ **仓库自带 18 个文档工具脚本**（**本次实测** `tools/` 下含 `check_anchors.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py`、`separate_citations.py`、`gen_scaffolding.py`、`gen_input_files.py`、`doccheck.py`、`md_lint.py` **等**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安装 lifelib／modelx、**未运行任何产品模型、**未核对任何监管引用是否真的可点**。
e.summary_hk: **lifelib-products**（`lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一個「**暫存區**」倉庫**，**逐字自述為**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib.**」**，**並逐字定性**「**It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-03、最後推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**Python**、**README 17,095 位元組**、**tarball 解出 1,835 條路徑**；**⚠️ 本次清單裡未見 `LICENSE` 文件**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **每個產品都有可執行的參考模型，且逐格斷言****（**逐字**「**each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell**」**）**；**② **六套庫都「**在形狀上就是 lifelib 的庫**」**（**逐字**「**they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link**」**）**；**③ **倉庫自带 18 個文件工具腳本**（**實測** `tools/` 下含 `check_anchors.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py` **等**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 lifelib／modelx、未運行任何模型**。
e.summary_en: The repository lifelib-products **is a staging area rather than a released library**, stating verbatim that it is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib and verbatim that it is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on, with each library written in the shape the upstream project expects and held to standard until it lands upstream as a library of its own. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-03**, **last pushed 2026-09-11**, zero stars, primarily Python, **a README of 17,095 bytes**, **1,835 paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file present**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and of the four it is the widest in coverage**: it holds **a library of product specifications for major life insurance products organised by country**, together with the documentation needed to build reference implementations of liability cash flow projection models. **Three passages are worth copying**: all fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model beside the documents that specify it, each reproducing its own technical notes worked example and asserted cell by cell; all six libraries are upstream libraries in shape, sitting at the path the upstream project puts its libraries on, rendering as Sphinx page trees, and **carrying regulatory citations that are working links**; and the repository carries eighteen documentation tooling scripts of its own for checking anchors, generating citation links and unlinking specification citations. **lifelib and its modelling engine were not installed, no product model was run, and no regulatory citation was checked for reachability this round.**
e.body:
**lifelib-products**（GitHub 仓库 `lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一个「**暂存区**」仓库**——**⭐ 逐字自述为**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib. It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on: each library under `lifelib/libraries/` is written in the shape lifelib expects, and is drafted, reviewed and held to standard here until it lands upstream as a lifelib library of its own.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-03、最后推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**、**README 17,095 字节**；**tarball 枚举 1,835 条路径**（**约 10.8 MB 压缩包**）；**⭐ 而**本次文件清单里**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****（**故本词条**不主张其许可状态**，**按惯例记作**权利不明****）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 本条的线索来自**本站已收录的 [[lifelib]]**：**由它所属组织的另一个仓库**往上找**，**发现了这个**体量大得多**的暂存区**。**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**按本站惯例（**同一作者／组织的**近重复姊妹仓库**须谨慎**）**，**本条**属于「**同一组织的不同产品**」**，**故本条目**只记录该仓库自述与实测结构**，**并未做任何代码层面的比较**（**即**不主张它与池内 [[lifelib]] 有或没有代码重合**）**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它收录的是**按国家组织的寿险产品规格 ＋ 参考实现文档****——**逐字**：**「**What it holds is a library of **product specifications for major life insurance products, organized by country**, together with the documentation needed to build **reference implementations of liability cash flow projection models** (lifelib/modelx style), organized by product type and country.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 覆盖范围被逐国、逐类写清，**且本次实测与自述一致****——**README 逐字**：**「**Current coverage: United States (6 individual life and 6 individual annuity product types), United Kingdom (7 product types, including pension annuities), Japan (9 product types, three of them 第三分野 health products), France (9 product types, five of them built on *assurance vie*), Germany (10 product types, organised on the *Drei-Schichten-Modell*) and Korea (10 product types, four of them 제3보험 third-sector products).**」**；**⭐ 本次实测逐库产品目录数**：**`uslib` 12、**`uklib` 7、**`jplib` 9、**`frlib` 9、**`delib` 10、**`krlib` 10**，**合计 **57****——**⭐ 与 README 逐字所写的**「**All fifty-seven products**」**及分国数字**逐项吻合**（**⭐ 本词条现场核对了这个加总：6＋6＝12、7、9、9、10、10 共 57**）**。**⭐ 即**这份清单**不是「**覆盖若干国家**」**，**而是**可以逐项点数**的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 每个产品都带**可执行的参考模型**，**且**逐格断言****——**逐字**：**「**All fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model in `<library>/products/<product>/`, beside the documents that specify it — twelve in `lifelib/libraries/uslib/`, seven in `lifelib/libraries/uklib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/jplib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/frlib/`, ten in `lifelib/libraries/delib/` and ten in `lifelib/libraries/krlib/`, each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**文档里的算例**」**与「**代码里的实现**」**之间**不是靠人读**对齐的**，**而是**逐格断言**（**asserted cell by cell**）**——**⭐ 即**每份技术说明里的那张表**都被当成**测试用例**。**⭐⭐ ④ 六套库「**在形状上就是上游的库**」**——**逐字**：**「**All six are lifelib libraries in shape: they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and **every regulatory citation in them is a working link**.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「**在形状上就是**」**——**即**这些库**不需要在合并时改结构**，**因为它们**已经放在上游要求的路径上**；**② ⭐⭐ **它们渲染成 Sphinx 页面树**——**即**文档结构也是按上游约定组织的**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **每一条监管引用都是可点的链接**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一条最实用**：**寿险产品规格里**监管条款是核心内容**，**而**引用一旦断链，**规格就只剩下说法**（**⚠️ 本次未抽查任何一条链接是否真的可点**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 仓库自带 18 个文档工具脚本**——**本次实测** `tools/` 下逐字含：`add_citation_anchors.py`、`check_anchors.py`、`doccheck.py`、`fix_doc_roles.py`、`fix_docstring_lists.py`、`fix_docstring_tables.py`、`fix_relative_links.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`gen_input_files.py`、`gen_scaffolding.py`、`md_lint.py`、`mdspans.py`、`rewrite_paths.py`、`separate_citations.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py` **等**。**⭐ 即**「**保持引用可点、**锚点正确、**脚手架一致**」**这件事被**工具化**了**——**⭐ 而其中** `unlink_spec_citations.py` **与** `separate_citations.py` **两个名字**尤其值得记**：**一个把法规引用**取消链接**、**一个把引用**分离出来**（**⚠️ 本次未读脚本内容，故不主张其具体行为**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 顶层另有**合并相关的文档**——**实测根目录含** `MERGE.md`、`USLIB-MERGE-PLAN.md`、`README.md`、`.gitignore`、`requirements.txt`、`doc/`（**含** `Makefile` 与 `make.bat`**）**、`lifelib/`、`tools/`**——**⭐ 即**「**怎么把它并进上游**」**也写在仓库里**（**⚠️ 本次未读这两份合并文档**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 状态与日期写明**——**README 逐字**「**Status:** Draft, 2026-08-30.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[lifelib]] 记录的是**上游库本身**，**[[modelx]] 记录其建模引擎**，**[[aggregate-python]]、[[mies]]、[[ifrs17-calculation-engine]]、[[cashflower]]、[[tryangle]]、[[pymort]]、[[heavytails]] 覆盖**负债现金流与精算建模**的相邻实现**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**按国家组织的产品规格 ＋ 逐格断言的参考实现 ＋ 引用可点性工具链**」这一组合**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**池内此前**没有**以「**产品规格库**」**为主体**的条目**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[lifelib]]、[[modelx]] 应当并读**——**它给的是**主要市场的寿险产品**如何被写成**可执行的规格**的一个大规模样本**（**六个国家、**五十七个产品、**每个都带可运行模型与逐格断言**）；**⭐ 而它对本站最有借鉴的一点是**：**「**文档里的算例**」应当被**当成测试**，**而不是当成人读的示例**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 lifelib 或 modelx、没有运行任何产品模型、没有跑任何断言**，**故不主张**这 57 个参考模型按所述工作、不主张其**逐格断言**真的通过**、也不主张其文档算例与代码一致**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何产品规格或技术说明的正文**——**本次只读了** `README.md` **与文件清单**（**1,835 条路径的目录结构**），**故不主张**任何一个产品的条款结构、**负债现金流口径、**或各国监管依据的具体内容**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未读** `tools/` **下 18 个脚本、**未读** `MERGE.md` **与** `USLIB-MERGE-PLAN.md`**——**故不主张**其工具链的实际行为与合并计划**。**④ ⚠️ 未核对「**每一条监管引用都是可点链接**」**——**本次**未抽查任何一条链接**（**未访问任何监管机构页面**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实许可**：**本次未见 `LICENSE`**，**故**记作**权利不明**而**不是**「**无版权**」**；**⚠️ 这也意味着其中的规格文档**不宜再分发**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者／组织背景**、**未核实与上游 lifelib 的关系细节**（**只读到自述**）**；**★0 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未做任何代码级比较**：**本词条**不主张**本仓库与池内 [[lifelib]] 有或没有代码重合**——**⭐ 这是按本站「**同一组织的不同产品可并存但须说明未作比较**」的惯例如实标注**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-03 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-11 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**按国家组织的寿险产品规格库 ＋ 逐格断言的参考实现 ＋ 自带引用完整性工具链**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（`notes’` 一处）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。
e.body_hk:
**lifelib-products**（GitHub 倉庫 `lifelib-dev/lifelib-products`）**是一個「**暫存區**」倉庫**——**⭐ 逐字自述為**「**This repository is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib. It is a staging ground, not a package to install or depend on: each library under `lifelib/libraries/` is written in the shape lifelib expects, and is drafted, reviewed and held to standard here until it lands upstream as a lifelib library of its own.**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-03、最後推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**Python**、**README 17,095 位元組**；**tarball 列舉 1,835 條路徑**；**⭐ 本次清單裡未見 `LICENSE` 文件****（**故不主張其許可狀態，**按慣例記作**權利不明****）**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**反向：誰接在我們已經收的東西上**」**——**⭐ 線索來自本站已收錄的 [[lifelib]]**。**⭐ 並如實指出**：**本條屬「**同一組織的不同產品**」**，**故只記錄自述與實測結構**，**未做任何代碼層面的比較**。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它收錄的是**按國家組織的壽險產品規格＋參考實作文件****（**逐字**「**a library of product specifications for major life insurance products, organized by country**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 覆蓋範圍逐國逐類寫清，且與實測一致**——**逐字**「**United States (6 individual life and 6 individual annuity product types), United Kingdom (7 product types, including pension annuities), Japan (9 product types, three of them 第三分野 health products), France (9 product types, five of them built on assurance vie), Germany (10 product types, organised on the Drei-Schichten-Modell) and Korea (10 product types, four of them 제3보험 third-sector products)**」**；**⭐ 本次實測逐庫產品目錄數為** 12／7／9／9／10／10，**合計 57**，**與自述**逐項吻合**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 每個產品都帶可執行的參考模型，且**逐格斷言****——**逐字**「**All fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model in `<library>/products/<product>/`, beside the documents that specify it — twelve in `lifelib/libraries/uslib/`, seven in `lifelib/libraries/uklib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/jplib/`, nine in `lifelib/libraries/frlib/`, ten in `lifelib/libraries/delib/` and ten in `lifelib/libraries/krlib/`, each one reproducing its own technical notes’ worked example, asserted cell by cell.**」**——**⭐ 即**文件裡的算例**被當成**測試用例**。**⭐⭐ ④ 六套庫「**在形狀上就是上游的庫**」**——**逐字**「**they sit at the path lifelib puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link**」**——**⭐ 三處值得記**：**在形狀上就是**、**渲染成 Sphinx 頁面樹**、**每條監管引用都是可點連結**（**⚠️ 本次未抽查任何連結**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 倉庫自带 18 個文件工具腳本**——`tools/` 下逐字含 `check_anchors.py`、`gen_citation_links.py`、`unlink_spec_citations.py`、`separate_citations.py`、`gen_scaffolding.py`、`gen_input_files.py`、`doccheck.py`、`md_lint.py` **等**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 頂層另有**合併文件**（`MERGE.md`、`USLIB-MERGE-PLAN.md`**）與** `doc/`**；**⭐⭐ ⑦ 狀態逐字為**「**Status:** Draft, 2026-08-30.**」**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[lifelib]]、[[modelx]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是主要市場壽險產品如何被寫成**可執行規格**的大規模樣本**；**⭐ 而它最值得借鑑的一點是**：**「**文件裡的算例**」應當被**當成測試**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 lifelib 或 modelx、沒有運行任何產品模型、沒有跑任何斷言**，**故不主張**這 57 個模型按所述工作、不主張逐格斷言真的通過**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何產品規格或技術說明的正文**——**只讀了** `README.md` **與文件清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀** `tools/` **下 18 個腳本與兩份合併文件**。**④ ⚠️ 未核對「**每條監管引用都是可點連結**」**（**未抽查任何一條**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未見 `LICENSE`**，**記作**權利不明**而**不是**「**無版權**」**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者／組織背景與與上游的關係細節**；**★0 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未做任何代碼級比較**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-08-03 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-11 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「按國家組織的壽險產品規格庫＋逐格斷言的參考實作＋自带引用完整性工具鏈」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用英文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`notes’`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

The repository lifelib-products **is a staging area rather than a released library**, stating verbatim that it is where reference models are drafted for merging into lifelib and verbatim that it is a staging ground rather than a package to install or depend on, with each library written in the shape the upstream project expects and drafted, reviewed and held to standard until it lands upstream as a library of its own. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-03**, **last pushed 2026-09-11**, zero stars, primarily Python, **a README of 17,095 bytes**, **1,835 paths enumerated from the archive**, and **no licence file present**, so no licence status is claimed and the rights are recorded as unclear. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and its lead came from a pooled entry**, since it was found by looking at another repository belonging to the same organisation as the pooled upstream library. **This entry states plainly that it records a different product from the same organisation, so only the stated description and the measured structure are recorded, and no code-level comparison was made.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, what it holds is a library of product specifications for major life insurance products organised by country**, together with the documentation needed to build reference implementations of liability cash flow projection models, organised by product type and country. **Second, the coverage is written out country by country and product class by product class, and it matches measurement**: the README names the United States with six individual life and six individual annuity product types, the United Kingdom with seven product types including pension annuities, Japan with nine including three health products in a specific Japanese market segment, France with nine of which five are built on a French life product wrapper, Germany with ten organised on a three-pillar model, and Korea with ten including four third-sector products. **The measured product directory counts per library are twelve, seven, nine, nine, ten and ten, summing to fifty-seven, which matches the stated figure item by item; this entry checked that addition on the spot, so the coverage claim is something that can be counted rather than a vague statement of covering several countries.** **Third, every product ships an executable reference model, and the technical notes worked examples are asserted cell by cell**: verbatim, all fifty-seven products ship an executable reference model beside the documents that specify it, distributed twelve, seven, nine, nine, ten and ten across the six libraries, each one reproducing its own technical notes worked example, asserted cell by cell. **The alignment between the table printed in the documentation and the code is therefore not left to human reading but asserted per cell: every table in a technical note becomes a test case.** **Fourth, all six libraries are upstream libraries in shape**: they sit at the path the upstream project puts its libraries on, they render as Sphinx page trees, and every regulatory citation in them is a working link. **Being in shape means these libraries need no restructuring at merge time, the documentation structure follows the same convention, and, most practically, regulatory clauses are the core content of a life product specification, so a broken citation would leave the specification as mere assertion, though no link was sampled for reachability this round.** **Fifth, the repository carries eighteen documentation tooling scripts of its own**, measured in a tools directory and including scripts for adding citation anchors, checking anchors, documentation checking, fixing roles, docstring lists, docstring tables and relative links, generating citation links, input files and scaffolding, markdown linting, markdown spans, rewriting paths, separating citations and unlinking specification citations. **Keeping citations clickable, anchors correct and scaffolding consistent has been turned into tooling**, and the last two of those names are the most interesting, one apparently unlinking specification citations and one separating them, **though the scripts were not read so their actual behaviour is not claimed**. **Sixth, the top level also holds merge documentation**: a merge file, a merge plan for one of the libraries, a README, an ignore file, a requirements file, a documentation directory with make files, the libraries directory and the tools directory, **so how to merge this into the upstream project is written down in the repository too, though those two merge documents were not read**. **Seventh, the status and its date are stated**: verbatim, draft as of 2026-08-30. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled upstream library entry records the library itself, the pooled modelling engine entry records the engine, and the pooled liability cash flow and actuarial modelling entries cover neighbouring implementations, while this entry supplies product specifications organised by country, reference implementations asserted cell by cell, and a tool chain for citation integrity. **This entry states plainly that no pooled entry previously took a product specification library as its subject.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[lifelib]] and [[modelx]]**, because **it is a large-scale sample of how life insurance products in major markets are written as executable specifications**, with six countries, fifty-seven products, and a runnable model plus per-cell assertions for each, and because **its most transferable lesson is that a worked example printed in documentation should be treated as a test rather than as an illustration**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, neither the upstream library nor its modelling engine was installed, no product model was run and no assertion was executed**, **so the fifty-seven reference models are not claimed to work as described, the per-cell assertions are not claimed to pass, and the documentation examples are not claimed to agree with the code**. **Second, no product specification or technical note body was read**: only the README and the file listing of 1,835 paths were read, **so nothing is claimed about any product structure, liability cash flow definition or the regulatory basis in any country; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, neither the eighteen tooling scripts nor the two merge documents were read**, so their actual behaviour and the merge plan are not claimed. **Fourth, the claim that every regulatory citation is a working link was not checked**, no link was sampled and no regulator page was visited. **Fifth, the licence was not established**: no licence file was seen, so the rights are recorded as unclear rather than as absent copyright, **which also means the specification documents should not be redistributed**. **Sixth, the author and organisational background and the details of the relationship to the upstream project were not verified beyond the stated description, and zero stars is not evidence of quality. Seventh, no code-level comparison was made, and this entry makes no claim about whether this repository shares code with the pooled upstream library**, following the project convention that different products from one organisation may both be recorded provided the absence of comparison is stated. **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-08-03 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-11 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a life product specification library organised by country, with reference implementations asserted cell by cell and a self-contained citation integrity tool chain, had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: the ASCII apostrophe appearing inside quoted English was rendered as a curved apostrophe so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
